response.text:
I can’t run tasks in the background or send messages later. I can, however:

- Do the research now and give you the results immediately, or
- Prepare a research plan / interim summary you can review later, or
- Draft an email, Slack/Teams message, or calendar reminder you can schedule or send to yourself, or
- Tell you how to set up an automated reminder (phone/calendar/email) to prompt you to check back.

Which would you like, and what topic, scope, and delivery format (summary, detailed report, bullet list, sources) should I use? Also tell me the deadline/time you meant by “later today.”
